references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 0
references.quote: The accessory uses, buildings and other structures permitted in each zone may include the following:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 1
references.quote: (a) In the RR-1 district:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 2
references.quote: (1) Open or enclosed storage of farm materials and equipment.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 3
references.quote: (2) Farm buildings, including barns, stables, sheds, toolrooms, shops, tanks, bins and silos.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 4
references.quote: (3) Fuel storage tanks and dispensing equipment for fuels used solely for farming operations. No wholesale/retail sales of such fuels shall be allowed as an accessory use.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 5
references.quote: (4) Wholesale and retail sales of agricultural products grown or raised upon the premises.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 6
references.quote: (5) Roadside stands for the sale of produce grown on the premises; provided, that such a stand shall not contain more than 600 square feet of floor area, the stand is located no closer than 20 feet from the right-of-way, and access to the stand is from an entrance to the farm or residence.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 7
references.quote: (6) Private, noncommercial antenna and supporting structure when used for amateur radio service; citizens band radio; a telecommunication device that receives only a radio frequency signal; a sole-source emitter with more than one kilowatt average output; and satellite receiving devices, provided they shall not be located in the area between the street and principal building nor within the required side yard.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 8
references.quote: (7) Fences as regulated by TMC 18.210.040 .

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 9
references.quote: (8) Gazebos, enclosed patios and similar buildings for passive recreational use.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 10
references.quote: (9) Home occupations as regulated by TMC 18.210.035 .

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 11
references.quote: (10) Private garages and carports.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 12
references.quote: (11) Private greenhouses or conservatories.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 13
references.quote: (12) Private recreational uses and facilities including but not limited to swimming pools and tennis courts, if the use of such facilities is restricted to occupants of the principal use and guests for whom no admission or membership fees are charged.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 14
references.quote: (13) Private or public utility transmission, distribution and/or collection systems; and not, however, including substations and distribution substations, pump stations, reservoirs, towers, transmission equipment buildings and similar facilitating structures.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 15
references.quote: (14) Residential accessory storage buildings for the storage of wood, lumber, lawn or gardening equipment and other materials and equipment, exclusively for the personal use of the residents of the premises, but not including a storage building for commercial purposes.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 16
references.quote: (15) Signs as regulated by Chapter 18.10 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 17
references.quote: (16) Statuary, arbors, trellises, flagpoles, and barbecue stoves.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 18
references.quote: (17) Structures for the shelter of household pets except kennels.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 19
references.quote: (18) Temporary construction buildings for on-site construction purposes, including cargo containers, for a period not to exceed the duration of the construction project.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 20
references.quote: (19) Little free libraries associated with residential uses are limited to a height of six feet, a width of two feet, and volume of six cubic feet, and to a height of six feet, width of four feet, and volume of 10 cubic feet when associated with nonresidential uses.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 21
references.quote: (b) In the R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, M-1 and M-1a districts: in addition to the accessory uses included in subsections (a)(6) through (a)(19) of this section, the following shall be permitted:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 22
references.quote: (1) Storage buildings and garages for the storage of wood, lumber, lawn or gardening equipment and other materials and equipment, exclusively for the personal use of the residents of the premises, but not including storage for commercial purposes. Truck bodies and cargo containers are not allowed as accessory uses. However, cargo containers may be used on a temporary basis as regulated by TMC 18.210.050 .

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 24
references.quote: (i) No farming equipment or farming machinery shall be parked or stored on a lot or tract of land unless within an enclosed lawful structure, or screened from view from any abutting property or street. No truck, excluding a pickup truck, trailer, boat, bus, tractor, or similar vehicle, machinery, or equipment with a curb weight (unloaded vehicle weight) or manufacturer’s gross vehicle weight rating exceeding six tons shall be parked or stored anyplace on a lot or tract of land within an R, M-1 or M-1a district.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 25
references.quote: (ii) No commercial vehicles or commercial equipment, machinery or materials of any kind shall be stored anyplace on a lot or tract of land, except if such vehicles, equipment, machinery or materials are in temporary usage to actively accomplish permitted temporary activities on the premises such as construction, repair, moving, and other similar activities. In such case they shall be removed from the lot or tract of land within 48 hours of completion of said activity.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 26
references.quote: (3) Off-street parking as regulated by Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 27
references.quote: (4) A child’s playhouse.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 28
references.quote: (c) In the M-2 and M-3 districts: in addition to the accessory uses included in subsection (b) of this section, the following shall be permitted:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 29
references.quote: (1) A maintenance storage building incidental to a permitted use, provided no such structure shall exceed 160 square feet in gross floor area, and shall be in keeping with the principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 30
references.quote: (2) A facility for leasing, managing and/or maintenance of a multiple-family dwelling or planned unit development, provided such facility is of such size and scale which is in keeping with, and is accessory in nature to, said multiple-family dwelling or planned unit development, all as determined by the Planning Director.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 31
references.quote: (d) In the O&I-1, O&I-2 and O&I-3 districts:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 32
references.quote: (1) For residential uses, the accessory uses included in subsection (c) of this section shall be permitted.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 33
references.quote: (2) Off-street parking as regulated by Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 34
references.quote: (3) A storage building incidental to a permitted use, provided no such structure shall exceed 400 square feet in gross floor area, and shall be in keeping with the principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 35
references.quote: (4) Employee restaurants and cafeterias, when located in a principal structure.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 36
references.quote: (5) Signs as regulated by Chapter 18.10 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 37
references.quote: (6) Fences as regulated by TMC 18.210.040 .

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 38
references.quote: (7) Flagpoles and statuary.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 39
references.quote: (8) Private garages and carports.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 40
references.quote: (e) In the C-1, C-2, C-3, C-4 and D districts: in addition to the accessory uses included in subsection (d) of this section, the following shall be permitted:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 41
references.quote: (1) Restaurants, drugstores, gift shops, clubs, lounges, newsstands, and travel agencies when located in a permitted hotel or motel.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 42
references.quote: (2) One independent, freestanding commercial structure of 400 square feet or less in the C-1 district and 600 square feet in the other districts shall be permitted on a zoning lot. Such accessory structure shall not be required to provide off-street parking, but shall be located as to not interfere with or reduce the amount of required parking for the principal use. The location of such accessory structure shall be reviewed and approved by the Planning Director at the time of building permit application, provided such location does not conflict or interfere with site access and interior vehicular circulation.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 43
references.quote: (f) In the I-1 and I-2 districts, the following shall be permitted:

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 44
references.quote: (1) Fences as regulated by TMC 18.210.040 .

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 45
references.quote: (2) Off-street parking as regulated by Chapter 18.240 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 46
references.quote: (3) Signs as regulated by Chapter 18.10 TMC.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 47
references.quote: (4) Gatehouse.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 48
references.quote: (5) Employee recreational facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 49
references.quote: (6) Flagpoles and statuary.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 50
references.quote: (7) Employee restaurants and cafeterias when located in the principal building of the use served.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 51
references.quote: (8) Employee child care facilities.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 52
references.quote: (9) Storage and warehousing.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 53
references.quote: (10) Caretaker’s or night watchmen’s quarters.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 54
references.quote: (g) In the U-1 district: the accessory uses included in subsection (c) of this section.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 55
references.quote: (h) In the MS-1 district: the accessory uses included in subsection (d) of this section.

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 56
references.quote: (i) In the X-1, X-2 and X-3 districts: the accessory uses included in subsections (b) , (c) , (d) , (e) and (f) of this section shall be in compliance with any applicable performance standards of the X mixed use districts. (Ord. 20062 § 32, 4-18-17.)

references.label: TMC 18.210.020 block 57
references.quote: Cross References: Planning and Development Department, TMC 2.20.080 .
